en: Commentary on the Essential Words of Master Xuedou Xian’s Verses on Ancient Cases, compiled by Chan Master Foguo Yuanwu: The Blue Cliff Record, Volume One.
Recorded while the Master resided at Lingquan Chan Monastery in Jia Mountain, Lishui Prefecture.
Commentary on the Essential Words of Master Xuedou Xian’s Verses on Ancient Cases.
